title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Flying Kamakiri #2 Pharaoh's Servant PSV-048 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features Flying Kamakiri #2, a Wind-type Insect creature with 1500 attack and 800 defense. It is a 1st Edition Common card from the Pharaoh's Servant set, with card number PSV-048. This card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection.
